content:
Anya M: Starting a staged promotion for model v3.2q (fp16 -> int8 hybrid quant). Need to lock down the gating rules and auto-revert thresholds before we open traffic.
Kyle R: 👍 what metrics are we using as the source of truth? latency, cost, quality?
Anya M: All three. Proposal: require two consecutive 15m windows that meet targets. Targets: p50 latency <= 120ms, p95 <= 320ms, golden-set regression < 0.5% absolute, hallucination score <= previous +0.2, token-cost delta <= -8%.
Samir D: For golden-set, is that the 1k prompt suite? Also what's our CI/uncertainty handling for small diffs?
Anya M: Golden is 1,200 prompts (mix of chat, completion, rerank). Use bootstrap 95% CI; if delta is within +/-0.25% and overlaps 0, treat as neutral (no promotion).
Olivia P: How about A/B tolerance? We should also not promote on tiny sample noise. I suggest min sample size 10k requests during the canary window.
Priya S: +1 to min sample. Also add a regression hysteresis: require two sequential windows and no single-window spike >1% regression.
Samir D: What about quant-specific checks? Int8 sometimes increases OOV hallucinations. We should run specialized hallucination and factuality evals (QA-exact, F1) and require no >0.3% drop on QA-exact.
Anya M: Agreed. Add metrics: QA-exact delta <= -0.3% and F1 delta <= -0.6%.
Kyle R: Auto-revert triggers? If any of the core metrics cross hard thresholds we should rollback immediately. Suggested hard limits: golden regression >= 1.0% OR p95 latency increase >= +120ms OR QA-exact drop >= 1.0%.
Olivia P: Also include cost runaway protection: if token cost increases >+5% unexpectedly, revert. Though with quant we expect cost down, this is defensive.
eval-bot: smoke tests completed: v3.2q -> fp16 baseline. perf: p50 118ms (baseline 125ms), p95 305ms (baseline 290ms), token-cost -12%. Golden-regression: +0.34% (CI [0.18,0.50]). QA-exact: -0.25% (CI [-0.40,-0.10]).
Anya M: eval-bot looks close: golden-regression +0.34% > our promotion threshold 0.5%? Wait our promote threshold was <0.5% absolute. This is +0.34% so it's OK. But CI upper bound 0.50 exactly at boundary—hmm.
Priya S: Our rule was CI overlap check: since CI upper == 0.50 and threshold is 0.5, it's borderline. We should require the upper CI < 0.5 to be safe. That avoids edge flips.
Kyle R: Good point. So change promotion rule: upper 95% CI < 0.5%. That makes this canary fail promotion.
Samir D: Operationally, implement hysteresis: if a canary fails the CI check but meets raw point estimate and other metrics, we schedule a second 15m window to re-evaluate. If second window passes CI rule, then promote.
Olivia P: Also add manual gate for any hallucination >0.3 absolute increase; require product sign-off for that.
Anya M: Summarize flow I'll implement in the deployment policy config:
```
- stage: staged_promotion
  windows: 2
  window_length: 15m
  min_requests_per_window: 10000
  metrics:
    - name: golden_regression
      promote_if: upper_95ci < 0.005
      hard_revert_if: point_estimate >= 0.01
    - name: qa_exact
      promote_if: upper_95ci >= -0.003  # allow small drops
      hard_revert_if: point_estimate <= -0.01
    - name: latency_p95
      promote_if: point_estimate <= baseline + 0.12
      hard_revert_if: point_estimate >= baseline + 0.12
    - name: token_cost
      promote_if: point_estimate <= baseline - 0.08
      hard_revert_if: point_estimate >= baseline + 0.05
  hysteresis: true
  manual_approval_for: ["hallucination_delta > 0.003"]
```
Samir D: Tiny nit: our JSON/YAML uses decimals as fractions; you used 0.005 meaning 0.5% — ok but let's be explicit in comments.
Priya S: Need to add monitoring hooks: if auto-revert happens, create a rollback ticket with diagnostics: sample requests, top-k logits diff, KV cache hit rate, GPU memory pressure snapshot.
Anya M: Yep. Also add canary routing policy: send to regionally matched hosts and limit fraction to 5% during windows then ramp to 25% on successful promote.
Kyle R: For A/B analysis, run two-sided test and post uplift with 95% CI. If the lower bound of quality metric uplift is negative beyond tolerated delta, block.
Olivia P: One more: record a lightweight reproducible eval snapshot (seeded) so we can re-run the exact golden-set later for postmortem.
eval-bot: noted -> will attach eval snapshot and sample diff to deploy logs.
Anya M: OK I'll update infra PR with the policy and tests. Thanks all — plan is to kick off a single 15m canary now and wait for window 2 if needed.
Kyle R: Good luck, ping @samir if it flails. :crossed_fingers:
Samir D: standing by.
Priya S: will monitor dashboards.
Olivia P: keep product on the loop if hallucination flags fire.
Anya M: launching canary 1809991300 now.
